description: This file defines the Office entity class for the Fineract project, including its properties, relationships, and methods for managing office hierarchy and updates.

classes.name: Office
classes.description: Represents an office entity with hierarchy management, creation, and update functionalities within the Fineract system.

methods.name: headOffice
methods.description: Creates a new head office instance with specified name, opening date, and external ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an Office object from JSON command input, associating it with a parent office if provided.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates office properties based on JSON command input, tracking changes.

methods.name: identifiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the office is identified by a specific ID.

methods.name: hasParentOf
methods.description: Determines if the office has a specific office as its parent.

methods.name: doesNotHaveAnOfficeInHierarchyWithId
methods.description: Checks if the office hierarchy does not contain an office with the given ID.

methods.name: loadLazyCollections
methods.description: Loads lazy-loaded collections such as children to initialize them.
